name: Kahlil Calavas
headline: Creative technologist · Spatial computing · Web development
summary: Creative technologist and CTO at TerraLux working across web platforms, digital twins, augmented reality, and immersive storytelling. Combines React, TypeScript, and Unity development with on-site capture, interface design, and a decade of professional web development. Builds tools and experiences that connect people, places, and ideas.

bullets: Develop and maintain The Futurist Network with React, TypeScript, and Supabase: a digital twin, project management, and social platform for designing, building, and funding businesses.
Develop a Unity-based iOS platform for world-scale augmented reality, connected to the Futurist Toolkit and location datasets.
Create architectural visualizations, digital twins, and 3D captures; demonstrate spatial systems through mixed reality map tables and public showcases.
Support technology operations, fundraising presentations, and investment outreach.
Maintained WordPress, Shopify, and Thought Industries learning platforms; integrated third-party APIs and plugins.
Developed headless WordPress experiences with Next.js 13, Vercel, and WP Engine, collaborating across teams using Git.
Built WordPress themes, plugins, and API integrations with cross-functional teams.
Managed backups, updates, quality assurance, and Git-based development workflows.
Developed WordPress themes and plugins, maintained websites across multiple frameworks, and deployed Firebase applications.
Built an internal web development code wiki and coordinated projects through GitHub.
Translated Sketch designs into interactive WordPress themes using Genesis and Advanced Custom Fields.
Maintained client websites, supported proposals, and improved accessibility for Connecticut library websites.
Migrated static websites to WordPress and developed custom themes, plugins, and search-optimized machine sales pages.
Created a machine directory combining video, photography, and interactive product presentations.
